tasks.instruction: Implement bounded property editing in existing connected global preview. Allowed files ONLY app/connected-global-preview.js, tools/connected-global-preview.html, docs/qa/claude-connected-edit-ui.md. Lead adds createConnectedGlobalPreview(doc,{installWorld: nextWorld=>renderer.replaceWorld(nextWorld)}); arrange let renderer then model creation then renderer creation, callback only runs for edits (not initial compile). Model API document() fresh snapshot; editEntities([{id,patch}]) supports ball position/radius and anchor position/radius/forward/up, spawn position; undoEdit(), redoEdit(), loadDocument(object), canUndo/canRedo getters. All synchronous, throw on invalid candidate; preserve current player/camera on success, halt forbids edits until reset. Renderer replaceWorld updates texture atomically; model.world getter updates. UI needs region/entity selectors with IDs/kind/chart label; numeric x/y/z/radius fields for ball/anchor (forward/up need not expose this increment), Apply edit, Undo/Redo, Download JSON, file input to Load JSON. Anchor radius edits must patch both connected endpoints together in ONE editEntities call (connections in baseScene plus envelope); other properties only selected entity. Stop pointer flight before edit; errors in separate role=status message, do not call fatal failure/overwrite old canvas on validation errors. Disable unavailable history; reflect current document after actions. Respect chart-local physical coordinates, no geometry/chart conversion or gizmos. Keep all existing tests/options. Add browser tests through actual controls: S3 radius edit -> pixels differ, undo document exact, redo -> save/load snapshot exact (model load acceptable for reload check), invalid radius retains document/history/pose/image, paired anchor radii change both and undo, play original route after roundtrip. Exercise file-load handler with Blob/File if practical. No renderer/engine/model changes; no browser or full suite in clone, syntax check only and report pending lead integration. No commits/pushes/agents. Use bounded form controls, not raw JSON textarea. Report under 400 words.
